body:
**Works fine on every uploaded Minecraft Version*
**Minecraft may show a compatibility warning when applying the pack—this is normal and the pack should still work.**

# Small Lower Shield by Silent!

## 📜 Description

This resource pack makes the **shield smaller and lower** while holding it in first person.

Perfect for **PvP** and **Survival** players who want better visibility without changing the vanilla style.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🔹 Smaller shield model.
* 🔹 Lower shield position.
* 🔹 More screen visibility.
* 🔹 Vanilla-friendly design.
* 🔹 No gameplay changes.

---

## 🎮 Best For

* PvP & Crystal PvP
* Survival gameplay
* Better first-person visibility
* Players who prefer a cleaner screen

---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Note

1. Tested on Vanilla Minecraft only.
2. Not tested with mods.
3. If another resource pack edits the shield model, place this pack above it in the resource pack list.
